activity.notes: Gyebaek was a Baekje general who commanded the 5,000-man force at the Battle of Hwangsanbeol in 660 and died in that campaign. The single attested campaign year is used as the representative Activity.

sources.title: 계백
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture identifies Gyebaek as a Baekje general who fought at Hwangsanbeol in 660 and died that year.
